name: Plant
description: A manufacturing site. Carries capacity (work centres, hours, spare units) and inventory (days of cover, stock value) as properties, because both are 1:1 with the plant rather than entities in their own right. A kind of Facility. In the supply chain model: A Plant can substitute for another Plant (N:N). A Plant produces a Material Category (N:N). A Plant ships to a Customer (N:N). A Plant transfers material to another Plant (N:N). A Sales Order is fulfilled by a Plant (N:1). A Supplier supplies a Plant (N:N). A System Serial is built at a Plant (N:1). An Equipment is installed at a Plant (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
